svg.text: Cut 146 mm of 160 mm pipe; saw square, file both ends flat and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 6 mm holes at the bottom edge, on opposite sides, so any

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: water that gets in drains out.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the bottom end stands in the 2 mm groove on top of the lid; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top end stops 1 mm under the generator plate, which holds it in place.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It covers both bearing units and the jaw coupling; nothing that turns

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: can be reached while the plate is on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: it stands in the groove and the plate clears it.
